out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Cold, humid sensation; smelled 'like something dirty'; bumped leg on something metal (heard 'noise of metals').

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Darkness/void-like space; later 'falling in the vacuum' at incredible speed.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Guided 'this way'; went around operating table in darkness; 'started to go up' holding a man; later fell in the vacuum at incredible speed.

arrival.other_being_detail: A male guide-like figure: golden skin, chestnut hair, clear eyes, dressed in brown; loving/peaceful demeanor; gave messages and showed scenes/images.

environment.environment_other_detail: Tree identified as 'The tree of life'; wheat-like stalks moving in breeze; later 'some part of the cosmos'; also 'movie screen' style presentations of planetary/earth changes; 'giant poster with lights' showing a person.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Briefly opened eyes in operating room, wanted to continue; then seemed to 'return' to the other scene; later 'fell in the vacuum' and woke in operating room.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Guide said: 'be ready, many things are going to happen, there are going to be changes, but the changes are for the better' and 'Start practicing for when you are here.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prophetic/visionary scenes (galaxy 'hole', celestial bodies/planet, dust in atmosphere, floods/mud, earth opening; people in white; words 'faith' and 'hope'; encounter with a dog; 'giant poster' revealing a person).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE into darkness, distant light, guided upward, then earthlike scene under 'tree of life' with guide; intermittent returns/awareness of operating room; later cosmos/darkness and a 'poster' vision; rapid fall and awakening.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to operating room briefly, then seemed to re-enter the other realm and see the guide again.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: X-ray-like perception of nurses' skeletons; strong olfactory 'dirty' smell and cold humidity in darkness; 'Tree of life' and Cabala image; prophetic disaster/cosmic scenes; words 'faith' and 'hope' felt/seen; rehearsal/practice instruction; dog encounter tied to 'in a few days'; 'giant poster with lights' revealing a person; intentional attempt to make the guide 'disappear' by command.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Soon you will be here.” “This way.” “The tree of life.” “Soon you'll be here but at this moment, starting now, this is going to be your place; starting now all is going to be okay in a little while, and all is going to come out okay.” “Be ready, many things are going to happen, there are going to be changes, but the changes are for the better.” “Hurry, somebody is coming: perhaps somebody that you know or that you will know.” “No, not that. That will be here in a few days”. “Start practicing for when you are here”. “Come, get close. I am going to show you somebody that is going to be here with you.”
